title: Grateful Dead Live at Ballroom, U. of Co. on 1969-04-13
lineage: SBD> MR> C> D> CD> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑energy ’69 show with standout Dark Star, Morning Dew and The Eleven; solid soundboard recording despite a few cuts.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the smoky Dark Star, soaring Morning Dew and an epic Eleven, noting Jerry’s searing runs and Phil’s deep bass. The Miller‑transferred soundboard tape sounds great for its era, though Lovelight and parts of Dark Star are cut off, leaving the set a bit incomplete.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers gave 4–5 stars and praised both performance and sound quality; only minor recording cuts prevent a perfect score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced (Miller transfer praised), but several song sections are cut off (Lovelight ending, part of Dark Star) leaving the recording incomplete.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong jams and smooth transitions keep the momentum high despite a few missing cuts; the show builds nicely from Lovelight into extended improvisations.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for blistering runs on Dew and soaring leads on Lovelight; described as pulling out all the stops.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted to be “in another musical world,” delivering deep, immersive bass lines.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey’s spontaneous clapping and dynamic playing highlighted during Dark Star.
